definitions.explanation: The act or place of crossing over something, such as a river, road, or body of water.
A convenient connection or opportunity, especially in the expression 渡りに船 (a boat at the crossing — a fortunate opportunity arriving at just the right moment).

examples.japanese: {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{飛|と}んで→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧いく⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧になった。
examples.english: The season has come for migratory birds to fly south.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{渡|わた}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要所|ようしょ}→要所：16575_yousho⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われて→使う：00473_tsukau⟧きた。
examples.english: This bridge has been used as an important crossing point since ancient times.
This is exactly what they mean by 'a boat at the crossing.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したい→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていたら→思う：00492_omou⟧、⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}して→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧⟦くれて→くれる：00724_kureru⟧、{渡|わた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧だった。
examples.english: I was wanting to move, and then a friend introduced me to an apartment — it was perfect timing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えていた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{矢先|やさき}→矢先：13663_yasaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スカウト→スカウト：11696_sukauto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{渡|わた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧だった。
examples.english: Just when I was thinking about changing jobs, I got a scouting call — it was truly a godsend.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form of the verb ⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (to cross). Used in compounds and set expressions.

KEY EXPRESSION:
{渡|わた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧: literally "a boat at the crossing" — describes a fortunate opportunity that appears at exactly the right moment. Similar to the English "just what the doctor ordered" or "a godsend."

COMPOUNDS:
- {渡|わた}り{鳥|どり}: migratory bird
- {渡|わた}り{廊下|ろうか}: covered walkway connecting buildings
- {渡|わた}り{歩|ある}く: to wander from place to place
- {渡|わた}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧: a fortunate coincidence
